q_vocab_c1_01_001.question: 什么 does 'cabe destacar' 表示 在 academic writing?
q_vocab_c1_01_001.correct: it is worth noting / it should be highlighted
q_vocab_c1_01_001.explanation: 'Cabe destacar' 是 a 正式 academic expression 含义 '它 是 worth noting' 或 '它 应该 是 highlighted'. 它 是 用过的 到 draw reader's attention 到 an 重要 point 在 正式 writing.

q_vocab_c1_01_002.question: 什么 does 'en lo que respecta a' 表示?
q_vocab_c1_01_002.correct: with regard to / as far as ... is concerned
q_vocab_c1_01_002.explanation: 'En lo que respecta a' 意思是 '与 regard 到' 或 'as 远 as ... 是 concerned'. 它 是 a 正式 linking phrase 用过的 到 introduce a specific topic 或 aspect within academic discourse.

q_vocab_c1_01_003.question: A modo de ___, podemos afirmar que los resultados confirman la hipótesis inicial.
q_vocab_c1_01_003.explanation: 'A modo de conclusión' 意思是 '由 way 的 conclusion'. 这 phrase 是 用过的 在 academic papers 到 signal final summary 或 closing remarks 的 an argument.

q_vocab_c1_01_004.question: 什么 does 'según los datos' 表示 在 a research context?
q_vocab_c1_01_004.explanation: 'Según los datos' 意思是 'according 到 data'. 它 是 用过的 在 academic writing 到 introduce evidence-based claims supported 由 empirical findings.

q_vocab_c1_01_005.question: 什么 does 'no obstante' 表示 在 正式 writing?
q_vocab_c1_01_005.explanation: 'No obstante' 是 a 正式 connector 含义 'nevertheless' 或 '然而'. 它 introduces a contrasting idea 和 是 considered more elevated 在 register than 'pero' 或 'sin embargo'.

q_vocab_c1_01_006.question: 在 light 的 above
q_vocab_c1_01_006.correct: a la luz de lo anterior
q_vocab_c1_01_006.explanation: '在 light 的 above' translates 到 'a la luz de lo anterior' 在 西班牙语. 这 academic phrase refers back 到 previously stated evidence 或 arguments 到 support a new point.

q_vocab_c1_01_007.question: 什么 does 'dicho de otro modo' 表示?
q_vocab_c1_01_007.explanation: 'Dicho de otro modo' 意思是 '在 other words' 或 'put differently'. 它 是 用过的 在 academic texts 到 rephrase 或 clarify a complex idea 为 reader.

q_vocab_c1_01_008.question: cabe señalar
q_vocab_c1_01_008.explanation: 'Cabe señalar' 意思是 '它 应该 是 pointed out'. Like 'cabe destacar', 它 uses impersonal 动词 'caber' 在 its sense 的 '到 是 fitting' 到 introduce noteworthy information.

q_vocab_c1_01_009.question: 你 是 writing a thesis introduction 和 need 到 present scope 的 你的 research. Which expression 是 最 appropriate?
q_vocab_c1_01_009.correct: El presente estudio se centra en analizar los factores que inciden en el fenómeno.
wrong: Este trabajo habla de cosas interesantes.
Voy a escribir sobre un tema que me gusta.
Aquí explico lo que pienso del asunto.
q_vocab_c1_01_009.explanation: 'El presente estudio se centra en' 意思是 ' present study focuses on'. 这 是 标准 正式 register expected 在 academic thesis introductions, 使用 precise 和 impersonal 语言.

q_vocab_c1_01_010.question: 你 need 到 acknowledge a limitation 在 你的 research methodology. Which phrasing demonstrates appropriate academic register?
q_vocab_c1_01_010.correct: Si bien este estudio presenta ciertas limitaciones metodológicas, los hallazgos resultan significativos.
wrong: El estudio tiene problemas pero no importa mucho.
Los errores del estudio no son tan graves como parecen.
Hay fallos pero los resultados son buenos de todas formas.
q_vocab_c1_01_010.explanation: 'Si bien' (尽管) combined 与 'limitaciones metodológicas' (methodological limitations) 和 'hallazgos significativos' (significant findings) represents balanced, objective tone 需要 在 academic writing 什么时候 addressing study limitations.

q_vocab_c1_02_001.question: 什么 does 'la patología' 表示 在 medical terminology?
q_vocab_c1_02_001.explanation: 'La patología' 意思是 'pathology', referring 到 study 的 diseases 或 到 a disease 条件 itself. 在 clinical settings, 它 encompasses causes, mechanisms, 和 effects 的 diseases.

q_vocab_c1_02_002.question: El tribunal dictó una ___ absolutoria a favor del acusado.
q_vocab_c1_02_002.explanation: 'Sentencia absolutoria' 意思是 'acquittal ruling'. sentence 意思是 ' court issued an acquittal ruling 在 favor 的 defendant.' 在 legal terminology, 'sentencia' 指 a judicial ruling 或 verdict.

q_vocab_c1_02_003.question: 什么 does 'el ensayo clínico' 表示?
q_vocab_c1_02_003.explanation: 'El ensayo clínico' 意思是 'clinical trial', a research study conducted 到 evaluate safety 和 efficacy 的 medical treatments, drugs, 或 devices on human participants.

q_vocab_c1_02_004.question: 什么 does 'la jurisprudencia' 表示?
q_vocab_c1_02_004.explanation: 'La jurisprudencia' 意思是 'jurisprudence' 或 'case law', body 的 legal principles established through previous court decisions 那 guides future judicial rulings.

q_vocab_c1_02_005.question: genome
q_vocab_c1_02_005.explanation: 'Genome' translates 到 'el genoma' 在 西班牙语. 它 指 complete set 的 genetic 材料 present 在 an organism. 'El gen' 是 a single gene, 当...时 'la genética' 是 field 的 genetics.

q_vocab_c1_02_006.question: 什么 does 'el peritaje' 表示 在 a legal 或 professional context?
q_vocab_c1_02_006.explanation: 'El peritaje' 意思是 'expert assessment' 或 'forensic evaluation', a technical report prepared 由 a qualified specialist ('perito') 到 provide evidence 或 informed opinion 在 legal 或 professional matters.

q_vocab_c1_02_007.question: A research team publishes findings about a new treatment 为 autoimmune diseases. Which term describes body's immune system attacking its own cells?
q_vocab_c1_02_007.correct: una enfermedad autoinmune: el sistema inmunitario ataca los tejidos propios del organismo
wrong: una alergia: el cuerpo reacciona a sustancias externas
una infección: bacterias invaden el cuerpo
una intoxicación: el cuerpo absorbe sustancias tóxicas
q_vocab_c1_02_007.explanation: 'Enfermedad autoinmune' 意思是 'autoimmune disease'. immune system ('sistema inmunitario') mistakenly attacks body's own healthy tissues ('tejidos propios'), unlike allergies 或 infections which involve external agents.

q_vocab_c1_02_008.question: 什么 does 'el protocolo' 表示 在 a scientific 或 diplomatic context?
q_vocab_c1_02_008.explanation: 'El protocolo' 意思是 'protocol', a 正式 set 的 规则 或 established procedures governing conduct 在 official, scientific, 或 diplomatic settings. 在 research, 它 defines methodology 和 steps 的 an experiment.

q_vocab_c1_02_009.question: la nanotecnología
q_vocab_c1_02_009.explanation: 'La nanotecnología' 意思是 'nanotechnology', branch 的 technology dealing 与 manipulation 的 matter at an atomic 或 molecular scale, typically below 100 nanometers.

q_vocab_c1_02_010.question: A lawyer argues 那 a contract clause 是 unenforceable 因为 one party signed under duress. Which legal concept applies?
q_vocab_c1_02_010.correct: Vicio del consentimiento: la voluntad de una de las partes fue coaccionada.
wrong: Prescripción: el contrato ha expirado por el paso del tiempo.
Novación: el contrato fue sustituido por uno nuevo.
Subrogación: una tercera parte asumió las obligaciones.
q_vocab_c1_02_010.explanation: 'Vicio del consentimiento' 意思是 'defect 的 consent'. 什么时候 a party signs a contract under 'coacción' (duress), agreement 可以 是 voided 因为 genuine free will 是 absent. 这 是 a fundamental principle 在 contract law.

q_vocab_c1_03_001.question: 什么 是 key difference between 'lograr' 和 'conseguir'?
q_vocab_c1_03_001.correct: 'Lograr' emphasizes achieving a goal through effort; 'conseguir' means to obtain or manage to do something
wrong: They are completely identical in all contexts
'Lograr' means to lose and 'conseguir' means to win
q_vocab_c1_03_001.explanation: 当...时 两者 可以 意思 '到 achieve', 'lograr' carries a stronger connotation 的 accomplishment 之后 sustained effort (lograr un sueño = achieve a dream), whereas 'conseguir' 是 broader, 含义 到 obtain 或 manage 到 做 something (conseguir entradas = get tickets).

q_vocab_c1_03_002.question: 什么 does 'carecer de' 表示?
q_vocab_c1_03_002.correct: to lack / to be devoid of
q_vocab_c1_03_002.explanation: 'Carecer de' 意思是 '到 lack' 或 '到 是 devoid 的'. 它 是 a 正式 动词 用过的 用来表达 absence 的 something: 'El informe carece de evidencia sólida' ( report lacks solid evidence).

q_vocab_c1_03_003.question: El candidato ___ un puesto de trabajo acorde con su experiencia profesional.
q_vocab_c1_03_003.explanation: 'Solicitar' 意思是 '到 apply 为' 或 '到 formally request', 用过的 在 professional 和 administrative contexts. 'Pedir' 是 a more general 和 非正式 '到 ask 为', 当...时 'solicitar' implies a 正式 process 例如 job applications 或 official requests.

q_vocab_c1_03_004.question: 什么 是 nuanced difference between 'realizar' 和 'hacer'?
q_vocab_c1_03_004.correct: 'Realizar' implies carrying out something planned or significant; 'hacer' is the general verb for 'to do/make'
wrong: 'Realizar' means to make real and 'hacer' means to destroy
They are exact synonyms with no difference
'Realizar' is only used in Latin America
q_vocab_c1_03_004.explanation: 'Realizar' suggests executing something 与 deliberation 和 importance (realizar una investigación = conduct a study), 当...时 'hacer' 是 everyday, 所有-purpose 动词 为 做 或 making things. 使用 'realizar' elevates register.

q_vocab_c1_03_005.question: 什么 does 'matizar' 表示 在 context 的 argumentation?
q_vocab_c1_03_005.correct: to qualify / to nuance / to add subtle distinctions
q_vocab_c1_03_005.explanation: 'Matizar' 意思是 '到 qualify' 或 '到 add nuance'. 在 academic 或 professional discourse, 它 指 refining a statement 由 adding subtle distinctions 或 clarifications, e.g., 'Conviene matizar esta afirmación' (这 statement 应该 是 qualified).

q_vocab_c1_03_006.question: 到 undermine / 到 weaken
q_vocab_c1_03_006.explanation: '到 undermine' translates 到 'socavar' 在 西班牙语. 它 意思是 到 weaken 或 erode something gradually, 经常 用过的 figuratively: 'socavar la confianza' (到 undermine trust). 做 not confuse 与 'subrayar' (到 underline).

q_vocab_c1_03_007.question: 什么 是 difference between 'aludir a' 和 'referirse a'?
q_vocab_c1_03_007.correct: 'Aludir a' means to allude to (indirectly); 'referirse a' means to refer to (directly)
wrong: They are identical in meaning and usage
'Aludir a' is more direct than 'referirse a'
'Aludir a' means to hallucinate about something
q_vocab_c1_03_007.explanation: 'Aludir a' implies an indirect 或 subtle reference (El autor alude a la guerra sin mencionarla = author alludes 到 war 没有 mentioning 它), 当...时 'referirse a' 是 a direct 和 explicit reference 到 something.

q_vocab_c1_03_008.question: prescindir de
q_vocab_c1_03_008.correct: to do without / to dispense with
q_vocab_c1_03_008.explanation: 'Prescindir de' 意思是 '到 做 没有' 或 '到 dispense 与'. 它 expresses deliberately choosing 到 省略 或 forgo something: 'Podemos prescindir de estos datos' (We 可以 做 没有 这 data).

q_vocab_c1_03_009.question: 你 是 editing a colleague's report 和 notice 他们 used 'detentar' 到 表示 '到 hold a position legitimately'. 是 这 usage 正确?
q_vocab_c1_03_009.correct: No, 'detentar' implies holding power illegitimately; the correct word is 'ostentar' or 'ocupar'.
wrong: Yes, 'detentar' is the only correct verb for holding any position.
q_vocab_c1_03_009.explanation: 'Detentar' specifically 意思是 到 hold power 或 a position illegitimately 或 没有 proper right, 当...时 'ostentar' 或 'ocupar' 是 用过的 为 legitimate office-holding. 这 是 a frequently confused pair even among native speakers.

q_vocab_c1_03_010.question: A novelist wants 到 convey 那 a character views world 与 excessive optimism 那 ignores reality. Which 动词 best captures 这 nuance?
q_vocab_c1_03_010.correct: 'Idealizar': atribuir cualidades de perfección a algo que no las tiene.
wrong: 'Optimizar': mejorar algo para hacerlo más eficiente.
'Visualizar': formar una imagen mental de algo.
'Imaginar': crear algo ficticio en la mente.
q_vocab_c1_03_010.explanation: 'Idealizar' 意思是 '到 idealize', attributing unrealistically perfect qualities 到 something 或 someone. 它 implies a distortion 的 reality through an overly positive lens, whereas 'imaginar' simply 意思是 到 envision, 和 'optimizar' 意思是 到 optimize 为 efficiency.

q_vocab_c1_04_001.question: 什么 does 'Le saluda atentamente' 表示 at end 的 a 正式 letter?
q_vocab_c1_04_001.explanation: 'Le saluda atentamente' 是 a 标准 正式 closing 在 西班牙语 correspondence, equivalent 到 'Yours sincerely' 或 'Yours faithfully'. 它 是 用过的 在 business 和 official letters.

q_vocab_c1_04_002.question: Me dirijo a usted con el fin de ___ información sobre el programa de becas.
q_vocab_c1_04_002.explanation: 'Solicitar' (到 formally request) 是 appropriate 动词 在 正式 correspondence. 'Me dirijo a usted con el fin de solicitar' 意思是 'I am writing 到 你 在 order 到 request'. 'Pedir' 将 是 too 非正式 为 这 register.

q_vocab_c1_04_003.question: 什么 does 'Estimado/a señor/a' 表示 as a 正式 问候?
q_vocab_c1_04_003.explanation: 'Estimado/a señor/a' 是 标准 正式 salutation 在 西班牙语 letters 和 emails, equivalent 到 'Dear Sir/Madam'. 'Estimado' literally 意思是 'esteemed' 但是 functions as conventional polite 问候.

q_vocab_c1_04_004.question: 什么 does 'Lamento las molestias ocasionadas' 表示?
q_vocab_c1_04_004.correct: I apologize for the inconvenience caused
wrong: I am sorry for the occasion
q_vocab_c1_04_004.explanation: 'Lamento las molestias ocasionadas' 是 a 正式 apology 含义 'I apologize 为 inconvenience caused'. 它 是 commonly 用过的 在 business correspondence 和 customer service communications.

q_vocab_c1_04_005.question: 如果您能……我将不胜感激
q_vocab_c1_04_005.explanation: “I would be grateful if you could”译为 'Le agradecería que',后面接虚拟式。这是正式请求中使用的礼貌委婉表达,比直接的命令式更显得有礼貌。

q_vocab_c1_04_006.question: 什么 does 'Quedo a su disposición para cualquier aclaración' 表示?
q_vocab_c1_04_006.correct: I remain at your disposal for any clarification
wrong: I am quiet about the situation for now
I stay at the position of clarification
I remain disposed to any clearing
q_vocab_c1_04_006.explanation: 'Quedo a su disposición para cualquier aclaración' 是 a 正式 closing phrase 在 business correspondence 含义 'I remain at 你的 disposal 为 any clarification'. 它 signals willingness 到 provide further information.

q_vocab_c1_04_007.question: 你 是 writing a 正式 complaint 到 a company about defective merchandise. Which opening 是 最 appropriate?
q_vocab_c1_04_007.correct: Me dirijo a ustedes para expresar mi disconformidad con el producto recibido.
wrong: Oigan, el producto que me mandaron está roto.
Quiero quejarme porque lo que compré no sirve.
Hola, tengo un problema con algo que pedí.
q_vocab_c1_04_007.explanation: 'Me dirijo a ustedes para expresar mi disconformidad' 意思是 'I am writing 到 你 用来表达 my dissatisfaction'. 这 正式 register 与 'disconformidad' (dissatisfaction) 是 appropriate 为 official complaints, unlike 非正式 alternatives.

q_vocab_c1_04_008.question: 什么 does 'Rogamos disculpen la demora' 表示?
q_vocab_c1_04_008.correct: We kindly ask that you excuse the delay
wrong: We beg for your pardon for the damage
q_vocab_c1_04_008.explanation: 'Rogamos disculpen la demora' uses 正式 'rogar' (到 request/beseech) 与 虚拟式 'disculpen' 到 politely ask forgiveness 为 a delay. 'Rogar' elevates register beyond simply 'pedir disculpas'.

q_vocab_c1_04_009.question: sin perjuicio de lo anterior
q_vocab_c1_04_009.correct: without prejudice to the foregoing / notwithstanding the above
q_vocab_c1_04_009.explanation: 'Sin perjuicio de lo anterior' 是 a 正式 legal 和 administrative expression 含义 '没有 prejudice 到 foregoing' 或 'notwithstanding above'. 它 是 用过的 到 状态 那 a new point 做 not invalidate previously mentioned terms.

q_vocab_c1_04_010.question: 你 是 drafting an email 到 a government ministry requesting an extension 为 a grant application deadline. Which phrasing demonstrates appropriate 正式 hedging 语言?
q_vocab_c1_04_010.correct: Tendría a bien considerar la posibilidad de ampliar el plazo de presentación de solicitudes.
wrong: Necesito más tiempo, así que extienda la fecha.
Quiero que me den más días para entregar todo.
Oiga, no me da tiempo, ¿puede alargar el plazo?
q_vocab_c1_04_010.explanation: 'Tendría a bien considerar la posibilidad de' 是 an extremely 正式 construction 含义 '将 你 是 so kind as 到 consider possibility 的'. 这 multi-layered hedging (条件式 + polite phrase + possibility) shows highest level 的 正式 register appropriate 为 government correspondence.

q_vocab_c1_05_001.question: 什么 does 'mola' 表示 在西班牙语中 colloquial speech?
q_vocab_c1_05_001.explanation: 'Mola' comes 来自 动词 'molar', which 是 西班牙语 slang (primarily 在 西班牙) 含义 '到 是 cool' 或 '到 是 awesome'. '¡Esa película mola mucho!' 意思是 '那 movie 是 really cool!'

q_vocab_c1_05_002.question: 什么 does 'currar' 表示 在 非正式 西班牙语?
q_vocab_c1_05_002.explanation: 'Currar' 是 西班牙语 slang 含义 '到 work'. 'El curro' 是 slang 名词 为 'work/job'. 'Estoy currando' 意思是 'I'm working'. 这 是 非常 常见 在 everyday speech 在 西班牙.

q_vocab_c1_05_003.question: Se me quedó la mente en ___ durante el examen y no pude responder nada.
q_vocab_c1_05_003.explanation: 'Quedarse en blanco' 意思是 '到 go blank' 或 '到 draw a blank'. full expression describes moment 什么时候 你的 mind suddenly empties 和 你 cannot 记住 anything, 特别是 during stressful situations like exams.

q_vocab_c1_05_004.question: 什么 does 'flipar' 表示 在 colloquial 西班牙语?
q_vocab_c1_05_004.correct: to be amazed / to freak out / to be shocked
q_vocab_c1_05_004.explanation: 'Flipar' 意思是 '到 是 amazed' 或 '到 freak out' (在 任意一个 a positive 或 negative sense). '¡Estoy flipando!' 可以 意思 'I 可以't believe 它!' 或 'I'm blown away!' 它 originated 来自 英语 '到 flip out'.

q_vocab_c1_05_005.question: 什么 does 'pasarlo bomba' 表示?
q_vocab_c1_05_005.correct: to have a blast / to have a great time
wrong: to throw a bomb at a party
q_vocab_c1_05_005.explanation: 'Pasarlo bomba' 是 a colloquial expression 含义 '到 有 a blast' 或 '到 有 an amazing 时间'. 'Lo pasamos bomba en la fiesta' 意思是 'We had a blast at party'. 'bomba' metaphorically suggests explosive fun.

q_vocab_c1_05_006.question: 到 是 fed up / 到 是 sick 的 something
q_vocab_c1_05_006.explanation: '到 是 fed up' translates 到 'estar harto/a'. 'Estoy harto de esperar' 意思是 'I'm fed up 与 waiting'. 当...时 'lleno' 意思是 physically full, 'harto' conveys emotional saturation 和 frustration.

q_vocab_c1_05_007.question: 什么 does 'tío/tía' 表示 什么时候 used as slang (not literally)?
q_vocab_c1_05_007.correct: dude / mate / pal (informal way to address someone)
wrong: a rude way to address a stranger
a formal title for elderly people
q_vocab_c1_05_007.explanation: 'Tío/tía' literally 意思是 'uncle/aunt' 但是 在 colloquial 西班牙语 (特别是 在 西班牙), 它 functions as 'dude', 'mate', 或 'pal'. '¡Eh, tío, ¿qué tal?!' 意思是 'Hey dude, 如何's 它 going?!'

q_vocab_c1_05_008.question: ir de cañas
q_vocab_c1_05_008.correct: to go out for beers / to go bar-hopping for draft beers
wrong: to go to the sugar cane fields
q_vocab_c1_05_008.explanation: 'Ir de cañas' 意思是 '到 go out 为 beers', specifically small draft beers ('cañas'). 它 是 a quintessential 西班牙语 social activity involving visiting several bars 和 有 a small beer at each one.

q_vocab_c1_05_009.question: 你的 西班牙语 friend says '¡Qué fuerte!' 之后 hearing surprising news. 什么 register 和 含义 does 这 expression convey?
q_vocab_c1_05_009.correct: It is an informal exclamation expressing shock or disbelief, meaning 'No way!' or 'That's crazy!'
wrong: It is a formal expression meaning the news is physically strong.
It means the news is about someone who is very powerful.
It is a medical term meaning the person feels strong.
q_vocab_c1_05_009.explanation: '¡Qué fuerte!' 是 a 非常 常见 colloquial exclamation 在 西班牙 用过的 用来表达 surprise, shock, 或 disbelief. Literally 含义 '如何 strong!', 它 functions like 'No way!' 或 '那's crazy!' 在 非正式 conversation.

q_vocab_c1_05_010.question: A group 的 friends 是 planning a Saturday night out. One says: 'Vamos a ir de marcha y lo vamos a pasar genial.' 什么 does 这 表示 和 什么 register 是 它?
q_vocab_c1_05_010.correct: Informal register: 'We're going to go out partying and we're going to have a great time.'
wrong: Formal register: 'We are going on a march and it will be wonderful.'
Neutral register: 'We are leaving on a journey and will arrive safely.'
Military register: 'We are starting a march and will complete it successfully.'
q_vocab_c1_05_010.explanation: 'Ir de marcha' 是 colloquial 为 '到 go out partying' 或 '到 go out on town'. Combined 与 'pasarlo genial' (到 有 a great 时间), 这 是 典型 非正式 youth 语言 在 西班牙 为 planning a night out.

q_vocab_c1_06_001.question: 什么 does proverb 'No hay mal que por bien no venga' 表示?
q_vocab_c1_06_001.correct: Every cloud has a silver lining
wrong: There is no evil that comes from good
Bad things never happen to good people
No harm comes without a warning
q_vocab_c1_06_001.explanation: 'No hay mal que por bien no venga' literally 意思是 '那里 是 no bad 那 做 not come 为 good'. 它 是 equivalent 到 'Every cloud 有 a silver lining', expressing idea 那 something positive 可以 emerge 来自 negative situations.

q_vocab_c1_06_002.question: Más vale ___ que nunca, así que empecemos el proyecto ahora.
q_vocab_c1_06_002.explanation: 'Más vale tarde que nunca' 意思是 'Better late than 从不'. sentence 意思是 'Better late than 从不, so let's start project now.' 这 proverb encourages action even 什么时候 delayed.

q_vocab_c1_06_003.question: 什么 does 'A quien madruga, Dios le ayuda' 表示?
q_vocab_c1_06_003.correct: The early bird catches the worm / God helps those who rise early
wrong: God helps those who are mature
q_vocab_c1_06_003.explanation: 'A quien madruga, Dios le ayuda' literally 意思是 'God helps those 谁 rise early'. 动词 'madrugar' 意思是 '到 get up early'. 它 是 equivalent 到 英语 proverb ' early bird catches worm', emphasizing diligence.

q_vocab_c1_06_004.question: 什么 does 'En boca cerrada no entran moscas' 表示?
q_vocab_c1_06_004.correct: Silence is golden / It's better to keep quiet
wrong: You should close your mouth when flies are near
Insects are attracted to open mouths
q_vocab_c1_06_004.explanation: 'En boca cerrada no entran moscas' literally 意思是 'Flies don't enter a 关闭 mouth'. 它 advises discretion 和 wisdom 的 keeping quiet 到 avoid trouble, 相似 到 'Silence 是 golden'.

q_vocab_c1_06_005.question: don't look a gift horse 在 mouth
q_vocab_c1_06_005.correct: A caballo regalado no le mires el diente
wrong: No mires al caballo en la boca del regalo
El caballo del regalo tiene dientes malos
Regalar un caballo es mirar sus dientes
q_vocab_c1_06_005.explanation: 'A caballo regalado no le mires el diente' 是 exact 西班牙语 equivalent 的 'Don't look a gift horse 在 mouth'. 两者 proverbs advise 是 grateful 为 gifts 没有 criticizing their quality.

q_vocab_c1_06_006.question: 'Quien mucho abarca, poco aprieta' 是什么意思?
q_vocab_c1_06_006.correct: 贪多嚼不烂,样样通样样松
wrong: 拥抱太多的人,抱得不够紧
大大的拥抱永远不够紧
伸手够得远的人,按得很轻
q_vocab_c1_06_006.explanation: 'Quien mucho abarca, poco aprieta' 的字面意思是“抱得多的人,握得少”。它告诫人们不要同时承担太多任务或责任,否则哪一件都做不好。

q_vocab_c1_06_007.question: 一位同事一直在抱怨自己的工作,却不肯去找新工作。哪句谚语最适合用来劝他?
q_vocab_c1_06_007.correct: 'El que no arriesga, no gana' —— 想要取得成果,就必须冒险。
wrong: 'Más vale pájaro en mano que ciento volando' —— 珍惜你已经拥有的。
'Ojos que no ven, corazón que no siente' —— 对问题视而不见。
'Perro ladrador, poco mordedor' —— 这些抱怨无伤大雅。
q_vocab_c1_06_007.explanation: 'El que no arriesga, no gana' 意思是“不入虎穴,焉得虎子”。它鼓励人们冒适当的风险,而不是困守在令人不满的处境中,这对害怕做出改变的人来说是恰当的建议。

q_vocab_c1_06_008.question: 什么 does 'Dime con quién andas y te diré quién eres' 表示?
q_vocab_c1_06_008.correct: You are known by the company you keep / Tell me who your friends are and I'll tell you who you are
wrong: Tell me where you walk and I'll tell you who you are
Walk with me and I'll know your name
Show me your path and I'll show you mine
q_vocab_c1_06_008.explanation: 'Dime con quién andas y te diré quién eres' literally 意思是 'Tell me 谁 你 walk 与 和 I'll tell 你 谁 你 是'. 它 emphasizes 那 人们 是 judged 由 their associations 和 friendships.

q_vocab_c1_06_009.question: Ojos que no ven, corazón que no siente
q_vocab_c1_06_009.correct: Out of sight, out of mind
wrong: Eyes that don't see have no feelings
The heart cannot see what the eyes feel
q_vocab_c1_06_009.explanation: 'Ojos que no ven, corazón que no siente' literally 意思是 'Eyes 那 don't see, heart 那 doesn't feel'. 它 是 equivalent 到 'Out 的 sight, out 的 mind', suggesting 那 not knowing about something prevents emotional pain.

q_vocab_c1_06_010.question: A student fails an exam 但是 discovers 那 failure motivated them 到 change their study habits, leading 到 much better grades. Which proverb perfectly describes 这 situation?
q_vocab_c1_06_010.correct: 'No hay mal que por bien no venga' -- The setback ultimately led to improvement.
wrong: 'Más vale tarde que nunca' -- They studied late but passed.
'El saber no ocupa lugar' -- Knowledge takes up no space.
'A buen entendedor, pocas palabras bastan' -- Smart students need fewer words.
q_vocab_c1_06_010.explanation: 'No hay mal que por bien no venga' (Every cloud 有 a silver lining) perfectly describes 如何 a negative event (failing exam) led 到 a positive outcome (improved study habits 和 better grades). proverb captures transformative potential 的 adversity.

q_vocab_c1_07_001.question: 什么 does 'el rendimiento' 表示 在 a business context?
q_vocab_c1_07_001.explanation: 'El rendimiento' 在 business 意思是 'performance', 'yield', 或 'productivity'. 'El rendimiento del equipo' 意思是 'team performance', 和 'rendimiento de la inversión' 意思是 'return on investment'.

q_vocab_c1_07_002.question: 什么 does 'el flujo de trabajo' 表示 在 a professional setting?
wrong: the flow of water at work
q_vocab_c1_07_002.explanation: 'El flujo de trabajo' 意思是 'workflow', sequence 的 processes through which a piece 的 work passes 来自 initiation 到 completion. 它 是 a 标准 term 在 project management 和 business operations.

q_vocab_c1_07_003.question: La empresa necesita ___ su modelo de negocio para adaptarse al mercado digital.
q_vocab_c1_07_003.explanation: 'Reestructurar' 意思是 '到 restructure', specifically referring 到 reorganizing a company's operations, finances, 或 strategy. sentence 意思是 ' company needs 到 restructure its business model 到 adapt 到 digital market.'

q_vocab_c1_07_004.question: 什么 does 'la escalabilidad' 表示 在 它 和 business?
q_vocab_c1_07_004.explanation: 'La escalabilidad' 意思是 'scalability', capacity 的 a system, network, 或 business 到 handle growing amounts 的 work 或 到 expand. 它 是 a critical concept 在 technology startups 和 software development.

q_vocab_c1_07_005.question: 什么 does 'el titular' 表示 在 journalism?
q_vocab_c1_07_005.explanation: 'El titular' 在 journalism 意思是 'headline', title 的 a newspaper 冠词 designed 到 capture reader's attention. 它 可以 也 意思 'title holder' 在 other contexts, 但是 在 media, 它 指 headlines.

q_vocab_c1_07_006.question: stakeholder
q_vocab_c1_07_006.explanation: 'Stakeholder' translates 到 'la parte interesada' 或 'el interesado' 在 西班牙语. Unlike 'accionista' (shareholder), a stakeholder 是 any party 与 an interest 在 或 affected 由 a business 或 project.

q_vocab_c1_07_007.question: 什么 does 'externalizar' 表示 在 business terminology?
q_vocab_c1_07_007.explanation: 'Externalizar' 意思是 '到 outsource', practice 的 contracting business processes 或 functions 到 external companies. 'La empresa decidió externalizar el servicio de atención al cliente' 意思是 ' company decided 到 outsource customer service'.

q_vocab_c1_07_008.question: la competencia desleal
q_vocab_c1_07_008.explanation: 'La competencia desleal' 意思是 'unfair competition', business practices 那 是 deceptive, fraudulent, 或 otherwise unfair 到 competitors. 它 是 a legal concept 在 commercial law.

q_vocab_c1_07_009.question: A software development team 是 discussing 如何 到 handle a product launch 那 keeps getting delayed. project manager suggests adopting a new approach. Which professional term describes 这 methodology?
q_vocab_c1_07_009.correct: Implementar una metodología ágil para iterar más rápidamente.
wrong: Cancelar el proyecto y empezar uno nuevo.
Despedir a todos los desarrolladores del equipo.
Ignorar los plazos y lanzar cuando esté listo.
q_vocab_c1_07_009.explanation: 'Metodología ágil' 意思是 'agile methodology', an iterative approach 到 project management 和 software development 那 delivers work 在 small increments. 'Iterar' 意思是 '到 iterate', making incremental improvements through repeated cycles.

q_vocab_c1_07_010.question: A journalist needs 到 protect identity 的 a source 谁 provided sensitive information about corporate corruption. Which professional principle applies?
q_vocab_c1_07_010.correct: El secreto profesional obliga a proteger la identidad de las fuentes confidenciales.
wrong: La ley obliga a revelar todas las fuentes en cualquier caso.
El periodista debe publicar el nombre completo de la fuente.
Las fuentes anónimas no son válidas en el periodismo.
q_vocab_c1_07_010.explanation: 'El secreto profesional' 意思是 'professional secrecy' 或 'source protection'. 在 journalism, 这 ethical principle protects 身份 的 confidential sources ('fuentes confidenciales'), which 是 fundamental 到 press freedom 和 investigative reporting.

q_vocab_c1_08_001.question: 什么 does 'la trascendencia' 表示 在 philosophical discourse?
q_vocab_c1_08_001.explanation: 'La trascendencia' 意思是 'transcendence' 或 '远-reaching significance'. 在 philosophy, 它 指 aspect 的 existence 那 goes beyond ordinary 或 physical realm. 在 everyday usage, 它 意思是 lasting importance.

q_vocab_c1_08_002.question: El concepto de ___ ha sido debatido por filósofos durante siglos.
q_vocab_c1_08_002.explanation: 'Identidad' 意思是 '身份'. sentence 意思是 ' concept 的 身份 有 been debated 由 philosophers 为 centuries.' 身份 是 a core abstract concept 在 philosophy, psychology, 和 sociology.

q_vocab_c1_08_003.question: 什么 does 'el paradigma' 表示?
q_vocab_c1_08_003.correct: paradigm / model of thought or understanding
q_vocab_c1_08_003.explanation: 'El paradigma' 意思是 'paradigm', a framework 的 thought, a model 的 understanding, 或 a set 的 accepted beliefs 那 defines a field. 'Un cambio de paradigma' (a paradigm shift) 指 a fundamental 改变 在 approach 或 underlying assumptions.

q_vocab_c1_08_004.question: 什么 does 'la conciencia' 表示 什么时候 used as an abstract concept?
q_vocab_c1_08_004.explanation: 'La conciencia' as an abstract concept 有 dual meanings: 'consciousness' (philosophical awareness 的 existence) 和 'conscience' (moral awareness). 'Tomar conciencia' 意思是 '到 become aware' 或 '到 raise awareness'.

q_vocab_c1_08_005.question: inherent / intrinsic
q_vocab_c1_08_005.explanation: 'Inherent' 或 'intrinsic' translates 到 'intrínseco' 在 西班牙语. 它 describes a quality 那 是 基本 和 永久, belonging naturally 到 something: 'el valor intrínseco' (intrinsic value).

q_vocab_c1_08_006.question: 'la equidad' 是什么意思?它与 'la igualdad' 有何区别?
q_vocab_c1_08_006.correct: 公平 / 公正;指根据每个人的需要提供相应的资源,而 'igualdad' 指给每个人同样的东西
wrong: 它们是完全相同的概念
'Equidad' 的意思是骑马,'igualdad' 的意思是平等
'Equidad' 只是经济学术语,'igualdad' 只是社会学术语
q_vocab_c1_08_006.explanation: 'La equidad' 的意思是“公平”或“公正”,即根据个人需要分配资源,以实现公平的结果。'La igualdad' 的意思是“平等”,即对每个人一视同仁。这一区别在社会正义的讨论中至关重要。

q_vocab_c1_08_007.question: A philosopher argues 那 human freedom 是 inseparable 从 responsibility. Which abstract concept 是 central 到 这 argument?
q_vocab_c1_08_007.correct: La autonomía: la capacidad del individuo de gobernarse a sí mismo implica asumir las consecuencias de sus actos.
wrong: La dependencia: el ser humano depende de otros para actuar.
La obediencia: la libertad consiste en seguir las reglas establecidas.
La indiferencia: la libertad y la responsabilidad no están relacionadas.
q_vocab_c1_08_007.explanation: 'La autonomía' 意思是 'autonomy', capacity 为 self-governance. philosophical connection between freedom 和 responsibility 是 rooted 在 autonomy: 是 free 到 choose 意思是 是 accountable 为 those choices.

q_vocab_c1_08_008.question: 什么 does 'la resiliencia' 表示 as an abstract psychological concept?
q_vocab_c1_08_008.correct: resilience / the ability to recover from adversity
q_vocab_c1_08_008.explanation: 'La resiliencia' 意思是 'resilience', psychological capacity 到 recover 来自 difficulties 和 adapt 到 challenging circumstances. 它 有 become a central concept 在 psychology, education, 和 personal development.

q_vocab_c1_08_009.question: la alteridad
q_vocab_c1_08_009.correct: otherness / the quality of being different or other
q_vocab_c1_08_009.explanation: 'La alteridad' 意思是 'otherness', a philosophical concept 那 指 recognition 的 'other' as fundamentally 不同 来自 oneself. 它 是 central 到 ethics, particularly 在 philosophy 的 Emmanuel Levinas.

q_vocab_c1_08_010.question: Two debaters 是 discussing whether morality 是 universal 或 culturally determined. Which pair 的 abstract concepts frames 这 debate?
q_vocab_c1_08_010.correct: El universalismo moral frente al relativismo cultural: ¿existen valores absolutos o dependen del contexto?
wrong: El capitalismo frente al socialismo: ¿quién tiene más dinero?
El optimismo frente al pesimismo: ¿quién es más feliz?
La ciencia frente a la religión: ¿quién tiene la verdad?
q_vocab_c1_08_010.explanation: 'El universalismo moral' (moral universalism) holds 那 certain ethical principles apply 到 所有 humans, 当...时 'el relativismo cultural' (cultural relativism) argues 那 moral standards 是 shaped 由 culture. 这 是 one 的 最 fundamental debates 在 ethics.

q_vocab_c1_09_001.question: 什么 does 'la metáfora' 表示 as a rhetorical device?
q_vocab_c1_09_001.correct: metaphor -- a figure of speech that directly compares two unlike things without using 'like' or 'as'
wrong: a physical transformation of one thing into another
q_vocab_c1_09_001.explanation: 'La metáfora' 是 a rhetorical device 在 which one thing 是 described as 是 another: 'La vida es un viaje' (Life 是 a journey). Unlike a simile, a metaphor 做 not 使用 'como' (like/as).

q_vocab_c1_09_002.question: 什么 does 'la ironía' 表示 as a literary device?
q_vocab_c1_09_002.correct: irony -- saying the opposite of what is meant, or a contrast between expectation and reality
q_vocab_c1_09_002.explanation: 'La ironía' encompasses verbal irony (saying opposite 的 什么 你 意思), situational irony (什么时候 outcome 是 opposite 到 expectations), 和 dramatic irony (什么时候 audience knows something characters don't).

q_vocab_c1_09_003.question: El orador usó una ___ al decir que había esperado 'un millón de años' para recibir la respuesta.
q_vocab_c1_09_003.explanation: 'Hipérbole' 意思是 'hyperbole', a deliberate exaggeration 为 emphasis 或 effect. Saying 'a million years' 用来描述 a wait 是 a clear 例子 的 hyperbole, not meant 到 是 taken literally.

q_vocab_c1_09_004.question: 什么 does 'el eufemismo' 表示?
q_vocab_c1_09_004.correct: euphemism -- a mild or indirect expression used to replace one considered too harsh or blunt
q_vocab_c1_09_004.explanation: 'El eufemismo' 是 a rhetorical device 那 substitutes a mild expression 为 something considered offensive 或 unpleasant. 例如, 'pasar a mejor vida' (到 pass 到 a better life) instead 的 'morir' (到 die).

q_vocab_c1_09_005.question: 什么 does 'el oxímoron' 表示?
q_vocab_c1_09_005.correct: oxymoron -- a figure of speech combining contradictory terms
wrong: a contradiction that is always an error
a figure of speech using repetition
q_vocab_c1_09_005.explanation: 'El oxímoron' 是 a rhetorical device 那 places two contradictory terms together 为 effect: 'un silencio ensordecedor' (a deafening silence), 'la oscura claridad' (dark clarity). 它 creates striking imagery through paradox.

q_vocab_c1_09_006.question: understatement / deliberate minimization
q_vocab_c1_09_006.explanation: 'Understatement' translates 到 'la litotes' 或 'la atenuación'. Litotes 是 opposite 的 hyperbole -- 它 deliberately understates something 为 ironic effect. 'No es mala idea' (它's not a bad idea) 什么时候 含义 '它's a great idea' 是 litotes.

q_vocab_c1_09_007.question: 什么 does 'la antítesis' 表示 as a rhetorical device?
q_vocab_c1_09_007.correct: antithesis -- juxtaposing contrasting ideas in a balanced structure
wrong: the answer to a thesis question
a statement that destroys an argument
q_vocab_c1_09_007.explanation: 'La antítesis' places two opposing ideas side 由 side 在 a parallel structure 为 emphasis: 'Es tan corto el amor y tan largo el olvido' (Love 是 so brief 和 forgetting 是 so long) -- Pablo Neruda. 它 creates a powerful rhetorical contrast.

q_vocab_c1_09_008.question: la sinécdoque
q_vocab_c1_09_008.correct: synecdoche -- a figure of speech where a part represents the whole, or the whole represents a part
q_vocab_c1_09_008.explanation: 'La sinécdoque' 是 a figure 的 speech 哪里 a part stands 为 whole 或 vice versa. 例如, 'Necesitamos más manos' (We need more hands) 哪里 'hands' represents workers/人们.

q_vocab_c1_09_009.question: A political speech states: 'We bring not war, 但是 peace; not destruction, 但是 creation; not despair, 但是 hope.' Which rhetorical device 是 primarily being employed?
q_vocab_c1_09_009.correct: La antítesis con anáfora: la repetición de una estructura que contrasta ideas opuestas.
wrong: La hipérbole: una exageración deliberada de los hechos.
El eufemismo: una suavización del lenguaje directo.
La metonimia: la sustitución de un término por otro relacionado.
q_vocab_c1_09_009.explanation: speech uses 'antítesis' (antithesis) 由 juxtaposing opposing pairs (war/peace, destruction/creation, despair/hope) 和 'anáfora' (anaphora) through repetition 的 'not ... 但是'. Together, these devices create a powerful rhythmic 和 persuasive effect.

q_vocab_c1_09_010.question: A writer describes a cruel character as 'having a heart 的 gold' 到 highlight gap between appearance 和 reality. Which rhetorical device 是 being used?
q_vocab_c1_09_010.correct: La ironía: el escritor dice lo contrario de lo que quiere comunicar para crear un efecto de contraste.
wrong: La metáfora: el escritor describe literalmente que el corazón es de oro.
La hipérbole: el escritor exagera la bondad del personaje.
El eufemismo: el escritor suaviza la crueldad del personaje.
q_vocab_c1_09_010.explanation: 这 是 'ironía' (irony) 因为 description 'heart 的 gold' directly contradicts character's actual cruelty. reader understands intended 含义 是 opposite 的 literal words, creating a powerful critical effect.

q_vocab_c1_10_001.question: 什么 does 'la corrida de toros' refer 到 在西班牙语中 culture?
q_vocab_c1_10_001.explanation: 'La corrida de toros' 意思是 'bullfight', a traditional spectacle 在 西班牙 involving a matador 和 a bull. 它 是 a highly controversial cultural practice, celebrated 由 some as art 和 criticized 由 others as animal cruelty.

q_vocab_c1_10_002.question: Don Quijote es considerado la primera novela ___ de la literatura occidental.
q_vocab_c1_10_002.explanation: 'Don Quijote de la Mancha' 由 Miguel de Cervantes (1605/1615) 是 widely considered 第一 modern novel. 它 introduced innovations like metafiction, unreliable narration, 和 complex character psychology 那 defined modern literature.

q_vocab_c1_10_003.question: 什么 does 'el flamenco' encompass as a cultural art form?
q_vocab_c1_10_003.correct: a combination of singing (cante), dancing (baile), and guitar playing (toque) originating from Andalusia
wrong: only a type of bird native to Spain
exclusively a musical genre with no dance
a form of bullfighting from Madrid
q_vocab_c1_10_003.explanation: 'El flamenco' 是 a comprehensive art 形式 来自 Andalusia comprising three elements: 'cante' (singing), 'baile' (dance), 和 'toque' (guitar playing). 它 是 declared UNESCO Intangible Cultural Heritage 在 2010.

q_vocab_c1_10_004.question: 什么 does 'la siesta' represent culturally 在 Spain?
q_vocab_c1_10_004.correct: a traditional midday rest or nap, reflecting the adaptation to hot climate and a social rhythm centered on extended lunch
wrong: a type of festival celebrated in summer
a Spanish holiday on the seventh day
q_vocab_c1_10_004.explanation: 'La siesta' 是 a brief midday rest traditionally taken 之后 lunch. 它 reflects 西班牙's Mediterranean climate adaptation 和 a social structure 哪里 lunch 是 main meal. Though declining 在 modern urban life, 它 remains culturally significant.

q_vocab_c1_10_005.question: Camino de Santiago (cultural/historical 含义)
q_vocab_c1_10_005.correct: el Camino de Santiago: an ancient pilgrimage route to the Cathedral of Santiago de Compostela
wrong: el Camino de Santiago: a modern highway in northern Spain
el Camino de Santiago: a famous Spanish restaurant chain
el Camino de Santiago: a type of traditional Spanish dance
q_vocab_c1_10_005.explanation: 'El Camino de Santiago' ( Way 的 St. James) 是 one 的 最 重要 Christian pilgrimage routes, leading 到 Cathedral 的 Santiago de Compostela 在 Galicia. 它 有 been a UNESCO World Heritage Site 由于 1993 和 attracts hundreds 的 thousands 的 pilgrims 和 hikers annually.

q_vocab_c1_10_006.question: 'La Tomatina' 指的是什么?
q_vocab_c1_10_006.correct: 每年在巴伦西亚的布尼奥尔举行的扔番茄节
wrong: 在巴塞罗那举行的番茄烹饪比赛
遍及西班牙全国的番茄丰收庆典
圣诞节期间享用的传统番茄汤
q_vocab_c1_10_006.explanation: 'La Tomatina' 是一个著名的节日,每年 8 月最后一个星期三在巴伦西亚的布尼奥尔举行。参与者互相投掷番茄,这已成为世界上规模最大的食物大战,吸引了来自世界各地的游客。

q_vocab_c1_10_007.question: A tour guide explains significance 的 'las tapas' 到 foreign visitors. Which description best captures cultural 含义 beyond just food?
q_vocab_c1_10_007.correct: Las tapas represent a social dining culture of sharing small dishes, encouraging conversation and community bonding.
wrong: Tapas are simply appetizers served before the main course.
Tapas are the main meal of the day in Spain.
Tapas are only served in formal restaurants for tourists.
q_vocab_c1_10_007.explanation: 'Las tapas' transcend mere food -- 他们 embody a social ritual 的 sharing small dishes ('ir de tapas') 那 fosters conversation, community, 和 leisurely dining. practice reflects 西班牙's emphasis on socializing 和 shared experiences over 正式, individualized dining.

q_vocab_c1_10_008.question: 什么 does 'el Día de los Muertos' refer 到, 和 which country 是 它 最 associated 与?
q_vocab_c1_10_008.correct: Day of the Dead, a Mexican celebration honoring deceased loved ones on November 1-2
wrong: A Spanish holiday celebrating Halloween on October 31
A religious fast observed in all Latin American countries
A day of mourning observed only in cemeteries
q_vocab_c1_10_008.explanation: 'El Día de los Muertos' (天 的 Dead) 是 a Mexican tradition (not 西班牙语) on November 1-2 哪里 families create altars ('ofrendas'), visit cemeteries, 和 celebrate lives 的 deceased loved ones. 它 是 recognized 由 UNESCO 在 2008.

q_vocab_c1_10_009.question: Las Fallas de Valencia
q_vocab_c1_10_009.correct: an annual Valencian festival featuring the construction and burning of large artistic sculptures
wrong: a volcanic eruption festival in the Canary Islands
a traditional Valencia orange harvest celebration
a failure commemoration in Valencian history
q_vocab_c1_10_009.explanation: 'Las Fallas' 是 a major festival 在 Valencia celebrated around March 15-19 (Saint Joseph's 天). Neighborhoods build enormous artistic sculptures ('ninots'), which 是 then burned on final night ('la cremà'). 它 是 a UNESCO Intangible Cultural Heritage.

q_vocab_c1_10_010.question: A student 是 writing an essay about 如何 Gabriel García Márquez's 'Cien años de soledad' reflects Latin American cultural identity. Which literary 和 cultural concept 应该 是 central 到 their analysis?
q_vocab_c1_10_010.correct: El realismo mágico: la fusión de elementos fantásticos con la realidad cotidiana latinoamericana.
wrong: El naturalismo: la descripción científica y objetiva de la realidad.
El romanticismo: la exaltación de los sentimientos individuales europeos.
El existencialismo: la angustia del ser humano ante la libertad.
q_vocab_c1_10_010.explanation: 'El realismo mágico' (magical realism) 是 a literary genre 哪里 magical elements appear naturally within a realistic setting. García Márquez's masterpiece 是 its quintessential 例子, reflecting Latin American cultural 身份 through mythology, oral tradition, 和 blending 的 extraordinary 与 everyday.

q_vocab_c1_11_001.question: 什么 是 register difference between 'empezar', 'comenzar', 和 'iniciar'?
q_vocab_c1_11_001.correct: 'Empezar' is informal/neutral, 'comenzar' is slightly more formal, and 'iniciar' is the most formal/technical
wrong: All three are identical with no register difference
'Iniciar' is the most informal and 'empezar' is the most formal
'Comenzar' is only used in Latin America
q_vocab_c1_11_001.explanation: These three synonyms 为 '到 begin/start' vary 在 register: 'empezar' (everyday), 'comenzar' (slightly elevated, literary), 'iniciar' (正式, technical, administrative). Choosing right one demonstrates register awareness at C1 level.

q_vocab_c1_11_002.question: 什么 是 precise difference between 'efectivo' 和 'eficaz'?
q_vocab_c1_11_002.correct: 'Eficaz' means achieving the desired result; 'efectivo' means actually producing a real effect in practice
wrong: They are perfect synonyms with no distinction
'Eficaz' refers to money and 'efectivo' refers to results
'Efectivo' is only used in military contexts
q_vocab_c1_11_002.explanation: 'Eficaz' (efficacious) focuses on capacity 到 produce intended result, 当...时 'efectivo' (effective) emphasizes 那 something actually works 在 practice. A treatment 可以 是 'eficaz' 在 theory 但是 not 'efectivo' 在 real-world application.

q_vocab_c1_11_003.question: El gobierno implementó medidas ___ para reducir la contaminación atmosférica.
q_vocab_c1_11_003.explanation: 'Drásticas' 意思是 'drastic' (severe 和 远-reaching measures). 当...时 'dramáticas' (dramatic) 和 'trágicas' (tragic) exist as false friends, 'drástico' specifically 指 extreme measures taken 到 solve a problem. sentence 意思是 ' government implemented drastic measures 到 reduce air pollution.'

q_vocab_c1_11_004.question: 什么 是 difference between 'austero' 和 'sobrio'?
q_vocab_c1_11_004.correct: 'Austero' means strictly simple, avoiding luxury; 'sobrio' means restrained, moderate, and elegant in simplicity
wrong: 'Austero' is positive and 'sobrio' is always negative
q_vocab_c1_11_004.explanation: 'Austero' (austere) implies strictness 和 deliberate avoidance 的 luxury 或 comfort: 'una vida austera'. 'Sobrio' (sober/restrained) implies tasteful restraint 和 moderation 没有 excess: 'un estilo sobrio'. 两者 convey simplicity 但是 与 不同 connotations.

q_vocab_c1_11_005.question: 什么 是 advanced antonym 的 'elogiar' (到 praise)?
q_vocab_c1_11_005.explanation: 'Vituperar' 和 'denostar' 是 elevated antonyms 的 'elogiar'. 当...时 'criticar' 是 a 常见-level antonym, 'vituperar' (到 vilify) 和 'denostar' (到 revile/defame) represent strongest opposition 到 praise, conveying harsh 和 public condemnation.

q_vocab_c1_11_006.question: 到 worsen / 到 deteriorate
q_vocab_c1_11_006.explanation: '到 worsen' 可以 是 translated as 'empeorar' (general), 'deteriorarse' (gradual decline 在 条件), 或 'agravarse' (becoming more serious, 经常 medical/crisis). Each 有 不同 connotations: 'La situación se agravó' ( situation worsened -- became critical).

q_vocab_c1_11_007.question: 什么 是 nuanced difference between 'perspicaz' 和 'sagaz'?
q_vocab_c1_11_007.correct: 'Perspicaz' means perceptive/sharp-sighted (seeing details clearly); 'sagaz' means shrewd/astute (using insight strategically)
q_vocab_c1_11_007.explanation: 'Perspicaz' (perspicacious) emphasizes keen perception 和 ability 到 notice subtle details. 'Sagaz' (sagacious/shrewd) implies 使用 那 perception strategically 为 practical advantage. A detective 是 'perspicaz' 什么时候 noticing clues 和 'sagaz' 什么时候 connecting them 到 solve case.

q_vocab_c1_11_008.question: escueto
q_vocab_c1_11_008.explanation: 'Escueto' 意思是 'concise', 'terse', 或 'succinct', describing something 那 是 brief 和 free 的 unnecessary detail. 'Una respuesta escueta' 是 a brief, no-frills answer. 它 可以 是 neutral 或 slightly negative (implying too brief).

q_vocab_c1_11_009.question: 你 是 writing a 正式 report 和 need 用来说 那 a policy 'failed completely.' Which synonym 是 最 appropriate 为 正式 register?
q_vocab_c1_11_009.correct: 'La política fracasó rotundamente' -- using 'fracasar rotundamente' for emphatic formal failure.
wrong: 'La política falló totalmente' -- too informal for a report.
'La política fue un desastre completo' -- too colloquial.
'La política no funcionó para nada' -- too conversational.
q_vocab_c1_11_009.explanation: 'Fracasar rotundamente' 意思是 '到 fail resoundingly'. 在 正式 writing, 'fracasar' (到 fail) 是 more appropriate than 'fallar' (more mechanical/非正式), 和 'rotundamente' (categorically/resoundingly) 是 a stronger 正式 副词 than 'totalmente' 或 'completamente'.

q_vocab_c1_11_010.question: A literary critic needs 用来描述 a novel's writing style 那 是 excessively ornate 和 over--top. Which pair 的 synonyms 和 antonyms 将 best frame 这 critique?
q_vocab_c1_11_010.explanation: 'Recargado' (overloaded/ornate) 和 'ampuloso' (pompous/bombastic) precisely describe an excessively decorated writing style. Their antonyms 'sobrio' (restrained) 和 'escueto' (succinct) represent opposite aesthetic. 这 vocabulary 是 基本 为 advanced literary criticism.

q_vocab_c1_12_001.question: 什么 does collocation 'tomar una decisión' 表示?
q_vocab_c1_12_001.explanation: 'Tomar una decisión' 意思是 '到 制造 a decision'. 在 西班牙语, decisions 是 'taken' (tomar) rather than 'made' (hacer). 这 是 one 的 最 重要 collocations 到 learn, as 'hacer una decisión' 是 incorrect.

q_vocab_c1_12_002.question: El profesor hizo ___ en la importancia de la participación activa en clase.
q_vocab_c1_12_002.explanation: 'Hacer hincapié en' 意思是 '到 emphasize' 或 '到 stress'. sentence 意思是 ' professor emphasized importance 的 active participation 在 class.' 这 是 a fixed collocation -- 'hincapié' 是 很少 用过的 outside 这 expression.

q_vocab_c1_12_003.question: 什么 does collocation 'prestar atención' 表示?
q_vocab_c1_12_003.explanation: 'Prestar atención' 意思是 '到 pay attention'. 在 西班牙语, attention 是 'lent' (prestar) rather than 'paid'. 'Presta atención a lo que dice el profesor' 意思是 'Pay attention 到 什么 teacher says.'

q_vocab_c1_12_004.question: 什么 does 'correr el riesgo' 表示?
q_vocab_c1_12_004.correct: to run the risk / to take the risk
wrong: to escape the risk by running
q_vocab_c1_12_004.explanation: 'Correr el riesgo' 意思是 '到 run risk' 或 '到 take risk'. 'Si no actúas ahora, corres el riesgo de perder la oportunidad' 意思是 'If 你 don't act now, 你 run risk 的 losing opportunity.'

q_vocab_c1_12_005.question: 到 file a complaint
q_vocab_c1_12_005.correct: presentar una queja / interponer una reclamación
wrong: poner una queja en un archivo
q_vocab_c1_12_005.explanation: '到 file a complaint' translates 到 'presentar una queja' (general) 或 'interponer una reclamación' (正式/legal). 动词 'interponer' 是 specifically 用过的 在 legal 和 administrative contexts 为 正式 claims.

q_vocab_c1_12_006.question: 什么 does 'dar por sentado' 表示?
q_vocab_c1_12_006.explanation: 'Dar por sentado' 意思是 '到 take 为 granted', 到 assume something 没有 questioning 它. 'No des por sentado que todos están de acuerdo' 意思是 'Don't take 为 granted 那 everyone agrees.'

q_vocab_c1_12_007.question: A manager tells an employee: 'Hay que poner en marcha el proyecto antes de fin de mes.' 什么 does 'poner en marcha' 表示?
q_vocab_c1_12_007.correct: to launch / to set in motion / to get something started
wrong: to put something on a march
q_vocab_c1_12_007.explanation: 'Poner en marcha' 意思是 '到 launch', '到 set 在 motion', 或 '到 get something started'. 它 是 a 常见 business collocation 为 initiating projects, plans, 或 processes. manager 是 saying project 必须 是 launched 之前 end 的 month.

q_vocab_c1_12_008.question: 什么 does 'llevar a cabo' 表示?
q_vocab_c1_12_008.correct: to carry out / to accomplish / to execute
wrong: to carry to the end of a rope
to bring to a finish line
q_vocab_c1_12_008.explanation: 'Llevar a cabo' 意思是 '到 carry out' 或 '到 accomplish'. 它 是 a 正式 collocation 用过的 为 completing tasks, projects, 或 plans: 'Llevaron a cabo una investigación exhaustiva' (他们 carried out an exhaustive investigation).

q_vocab_c1_12_009.question: hacer caso omiso de
wrong: to make a house out of something
q_vocab_c1_12_009.explanation: 'Hacer caso omiso de' 意思是 '到 disregard' 或 '到 deliberately ignore'. 它 implies a conscious choice 到 overlook something: 'Hizo caso omiso de las advertencias' (He disregarded warnings). 它 是 more 正式 than simply 'ignorar'.

q_vocab_c1_12_010.question: 一个研究团队向利益相关方介绍研究成果。首席研究员说:'Los resultados arrojan luz sobre un fenómeno hasta ahora desconocido.' 'arrojar luz sobre' 是什么意思?它为什么重要?
q_vocab_c1_12_010.correct: 'Arrojar luz sobre' 意为“阐明、揭示”(shed light on)——表示这项研究澄清或揭示了此前未知的事物。
wrong: 意思是研究在实验过程中真的产生了光。
意思是结果太亮了,需要调暗一些。
意思是在演示过程中把聚光灯投向观众。
q_vocab_c1_12_010.explanation: 'Arrojar luz sobre'(阐明、使明朗)是学术和职场中的重要搭配,意为澄清或照亮。与 'los resultados arrojan'(结果揭示了)连用,是研究报告中介绍能够推进认知的重要发现时的标准说法。
